candidate_state: planned from the verified release-preparation commit

search_v2.reason: The completed comparisons used an excluded external evaluator; the clean material-only gate was not complete before release.

internal_measurement.results: Workspace release tests, Clippy with warnings denied, rustfmt, default dependency isolation, opening-book feature tests, USI state-transition smoke, public-contract checks, WebAssembly Chrome tests, and package generation passed. The clean material-only TT-bucket gate passed its pre-registered paired-trinomial SPRT and TT_BUCKET=3 is enabled. SEARCH_V2, FL_MOVE, adaptive time management, increment use, and the deeper null-move reduction remain disabled by default.

external_opponents.configuration: No external engine, evaluator, weights, labels, Suisho5-derived scores, or Suisho5-derived opening positions are used as release evidence for v0.3.59.

known_limitations: SEARCH_V2 is experimental and opt-in; its completed external-evaluator comparisons are excluded from release evidence and it is not the default search.
FL_MOVE, adaptive time management, IncrementUsePercent=75, and the deeper null-move reduction candidate are disabled by default because their clean release gates are incomplete or inconclusive.
Parallel search can vary by scheduler; deterministic diagnostics require one thread and SpecTopN=0.
No general playing-strength or external-engine superiority claim is made for this release.
No new NNUE checkpoint is bundled or adopted; the optional v0.3.38 checkpoint and its material-baseline recommendation remain unchanged.
The WebAssembly package is distributed as a GitHub Release asset and is not published to the npm registry.
External HalfKP inference remains optional and requires a separately obtained, license-compatible nn.bin file with its own provenance and operating scale.
